items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and authorize no spend, billing changes, money movement, monetization expansion, or new queue work. Revenue evidence is limited to Amazon’s 2026-09-21 aggregate result: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission; $0 is site-attributed and $4.92 remains unattributed because the provider aggregate row cannot be assigned to sites. September 2026 AI usage is $950.44 across 5,316 calls, but it cannot be compared to that one revenue day. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, budget exposure, forecasts, and causal lift are unknown. Continue only the existing period-aligned finance reconciliation and measurement work.

Finance disposition: reject vanity-metric or forecast claims based on 14,734 impressions, 150 clicks, 1,010 sessions, 15 conversions, 6,219 affiliate clicks, shipped output, or AI call volume alone. Minimum evidence for a contribution-margin decision is a dated ledger matching revenue, AI cost, infrastructure cost, domain/hosting cost, labor or execution cost, and other direct costs to the same site/content and period, plus a defined learning threshold. Preserve unavailable fields as unknown and do not extrapolate.

Budget exposure cannot be calculated because monthly spend limit, fixed costs, marketing budget, and revenue floor are blank in the 2026-09-30 brief. Infrastructure spend is not present in the authoritative snapshot. Cost-to-learn cannot be calculated because experiment-level allocated costs, exposure windows, incremental outcomes, and an approved learning threshold are absent. Continue reconciliation using existing records only; do not request duplicate telemetry or authorize spend.
